claim: **他把「意见」标成意见，紧接着交代这个意见靠什么立住。** 1919 年谈高压绝缘劣化：「I wish now to express the opinion that the deterioration in mica at least, is due more to corona heat and corona bombard- ment, than to chemical action」——先标明这是意见；下一句就是「This opinion is based upon both theoretical analysis and experimental evidence.」，再接「Speaking first from the theoretical point of view」逐条展开。（`bombard- ment` 是跨行连字符，**照录**。）
contexts: 电机绝缘：云母劣化成因的学会讨论
教育与工程师训练：对 Steinmetz 论文的评议
evidence_clusters: I wish now to express the opinion that the deterioration in mica at least, is due more to corona heat and corona bombard- ment, than to chemical action
This opinion is based upon both theoretical analysis and experimental evidence.
I believe thoroughly in the value of a careful study of the classics for engineers as well as for men of other professions, but I cannot believe that this study is as vital as here described
alternative_explanations: 学会讨论的体例本就鼓励发言人区分事实与看法，因此这可能是**场合的规矩**而非他个人的习惯。★ 本语料无法排除——同场其他发言人是否也这么做，未逐条比对。
falsifiers: 若同卷其他发言人普遍也在「意见」后紧接凭据，则这是体例特征不是他的特征
若找到他某处只下判断而不给凭据的发言，本条要降为「多数情况下」

claim: **被人误读时，他先纠正对自己的归类，再重述自己原本的意思——不是先反驳对方。** 1909 年：「I must have expressed myself poorly indeed to be classed by Mr. Osgood as an advocate of a narrow education.」——把责任先归到自己没说清；1919 年：「First, I want tosay that I fear Mr. _ Peek has misinterpreted my statement, which I intended to be something like this—」，随后逐字重述本意。（`tosay`、`Mr. _ Peek` 是 OCR 原样，**照录**。）
evidence_clusters: I must have expressed myself poorly indeed to be classed by Mr. Osgood as an advocate of a narrow education.
First, I want tosay that I fear Mr. _ Peek has misinterpreted my statement, which I intended to be something like this—
alternative_explanations: 这可能是学会场合的礼貌套式，而非他的思维习惯。★ 不能排除。
falsifiers: 若找到他直接指对方错而不先自省表述的发言，本条要收窄
若同代其他发言人普遍用同一句式开场，则是套式不是特征

claim: **他会明说自己的感受是混合的，而不是把立场压成一边。** 评议 Steinmetz 论文时开口就是「I must confess to mixed feelings which are difficult to express satisfactorily.」，随后两面都说：先「I have the greatest sympathy with Dr. Steinmetz’s general point of view.」，再「I believe thoroughly in the value of a careful study of the classics for engineers as well as for men of other professions, but I cannot believe that this study is as vital as here described」。
evidence_clusters: I must confess to mixed feelings which are difficult to express satisfactorily.
That may be one of the objects, but I feel’ very strongly that more emphasis should be laid upon
alternative_explanations: 「混合的感受」也可能只是缓和异议的修辞，实际立场并不含混。★ 本条只陈述他这么说，**不推断他心里如何**。
falsifiers: 若他在别处对同一议题给出单边立场且无保留，本条要限定到这一场
若「mixed feelings」之后并无两面陈述，则这只是客套

claim: **转述别人时逐字引并点名，自己的推论与别人的话分开写。** 谈电缆绝缘时他写「An interesting contribution to the discussion referred to above, was that of Mr. W. I. Middleton, who pointed out that」，随后把 Middleton 与 Morss 的结论标成「This equation was shown by Mr. Middleton and Mr. Henry A. Morss to be amply confirmed by a great number of tests, so that it is in no sense theoretical or speculative」。★ **该段里的第一人称是 Middleton 的引语，不是他的话**——写断言时不得据此当作他的经验。
contexts: 云母劣化成因的分项论证
evidence_clusters: was that of Mr. W. I. Middleton, who pointed out that
This equation was shown by Mr. Middleton and Mr. Henry A. Morss to be amply confirmed by a great number of tests
alternative_explanations: 技术论文体例本就要求标注他人贡献，因此这可能是**体例**不是个人习惯。★ 不能排除。
falsifiers: 若找到他把他人结论直接写成己见的地方，本条不成立

claim: **可考事实：1918–1919 年任美国电气工程师学会会长，1919-06-24 于 Lake Placid 年会作会长致辞《Cooperation》。** 该篇首行照录：`COOPERATION / PRESIDENT'S ADDRESS / BY C. A. ADAMS`，Transactions 卷 XXXVIII pp.783–793，篇幅 26,033 字符，整篇第一人称。★ 生年 1868-11-01 有同代依据（Who's Who in Engineering **第二版 1925**，本人供稿）；**卒年只有二手、Lamme 奖年份两源打架，本产物一律不写那三个数。**
contexts: 学会职务与年会致辞（一手）
同代名录里的生年（一手，本人供稿）
evidence_clusters: COOPERATION PRESIDENT'S ADDRESS BY C. A. ADAMS
alternative_explanations: 会长任期的起止月份未逐月核，只核到「1918–1919 年度」。
falsifiers: 若卷 XXXVIII 的会长署名不是他，本条主体不成立
若找到同代讣告给出与二手不同的卒年，`unresolved` 那一条要改写
